title: Witness introduction for the IMO 2025 P4 counterexample sequence
intent: Prove the headline existence theorem of the IMO 2025 P4 counterexample sequence — every starting value a0 = 6·12^k·n with n coprime to 10 begins an infinite sequence of positive integers whose successor is the sum of the three largest proper divisors — by naming the witness a m = 6·12^(k−m)·13^m·n (constant 6·13^k·n after index k), then discharging each of the three conjuncts of the existential from one of four named lemmas.
also_known_as: use ⟨w⟩ then one constructor per property
name the witness with `use`, then refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

parent.name: imo2025_p4_right
parent.statement:
theorem imo2025_p4_right (a0 k n : ℕ)
  (hn : Nat.Coprime n 10)
  (ha0 : a0 = 6 * 12 ^ k * n) :
  ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n : ℕ, a n > 0) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ b c d : ℕ, b < c ∧ c < d ∧ d < a n ∧ b ∣ a n ∧ c ∣ a n ∧ d ∣ a n ∧ (∀ e : ℕ, e < a n → e ∣ a n → e ≤ b ∨ e = c ∨ e = d) ∧ a (n + 1) = b + c + d) ∧ (a 0 = a0)

children.name: imo2025_p4_right8_h1
children.statement:
lemma imo2025_p4_right8_h1 (a0 k n : ℕ)
  (hn : Nat.Coprime n 10)
  (ha0 : a0 = 6 * 12 ^ k * n):
  n ≥ 1
children.closed_by: by_contra h; n = 0 by omega; rw [n = 0] at hn; norm_num at hn; contradiction

children.name: imo2025_p4_right8_h2
children.statement:
lemma imo2025_p4_right8_h2 (a0 k n : ℕ)
  (hn : Nat.Coprime n 10)
  (ha0 : a0 = 6 * 12 ^ k * n)
  (h1 : n ≥ 1):
  ∀ m : ℕ, (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) > 0
children.closed_by: by_cases h3 : m ≤ k; each branch shows the product is positive via Nat.one_le_pow (12^(k-m) ≥ 1, 13^m ≥ 1) and positivity, then simp [h3]; linarith

children.name: imo2025_p4_right8_h3
children.statement:
lemma imo2025_p4_right8_h3 (a0 k n : ℕ)
  (hn : Nat.Coprime n 10)
  (ha0 : a0 = 6 * 12 ^ k * n)
  (h1 : n ≥ 1)
  (h2 : ∀ m : ℕ, (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) > 0):
  ∀ m : ℕ, (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) > 3
children.closed_by: by_cases h3 : m ≤ k; each branch lowers the product to ≥ 6 via Nat.one_le_pow and nlinarith (m ≤ k: 6·12^(k-m)·13^m·n ≥ 6·1·1·1; ¬(m ≤ k): 6·13^k·n ≥ 6·1), then simp [h3]; linarith

children.name: imo2025_p4_right1_main
children.statement:
lemma imo2025_p4_right1_main (a0 k n : ℕ)
  (hn : Nat.Coprime n 10)
  (ha0 : a0 = 6 * 12 ^ k * n)
  (h1 : n ≥ 1)
  (h2 : ∀ m : ℕ, (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) > 0)
  (h3 : ∀ m : ℕ, (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) > 3):
  ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ b c d : ℕ, b < c ∧ c < d ∧ d < (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) ∧
    b ∣ (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) ∧
    c ∣ (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) ∧
    d ∣ (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) ∧
    (∀ e : ℕ, e < (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) →
      e ∣ (if m ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - m) * 13 ^ m * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) →
      e ≤ b ∨ e = c ∨ e = d) ∧
    (if (m + 1) ≤ k then 6 * 12 ^ (k - (m + 1)) * 13 ^ (m + 1) * n else 6 * 13 ^ k * n) =
    b + c + d
children.closed_by: self-contained by by_cases h4 : m ≥ k; in the m ≥ k branch it writes X = 6·s with s = 13^k·n and returns the witness ⟨s, 2s, 3s⟩; in the m < k branch it writes X = 12·t and returns ⟨3t, 4t, 6t⟩; each branch closes with omega/nlinarith/ring/aesop using only h2 and h3 and no further project lemma

applicability.goal_shape: an existential goal ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ, P a whose body is a conjunction of properties of the sequence (every term positive, every term admits the three-largest-proper-divisor decomposition, a 0 = a0); the witness is a single closed-form term a m = 6·12^(k−m)·13^m·n with an `if m ≤ k` branch, and each conjunct is closed by a separate pre-stated lemma
applicability.use_when: the witness is one closed-form candidate whose properties are already factored into named lemmas (a bound n ≥ 1, positivity, a lower bound > 3, the divisor decomposition), so each conjunct closes by one lemma application plus the `use`/`constructor` packaging
applicability.avoid_when: the witness must be assembled interactively from several choices rather than written as one term; the conjuncts must be proved jointly instead of one per lemma; or the candidate's properties are not already named, so the glue would have to re-derive them inline

claims.claim: The authors state the informal problem as a doc comment directly above the theorem: 'The infinite sequence a_1, a_2, … consists of positive integers, each of which has at least three proper divisors. For each n ≥ 1, the integer a_{n+1} is the sum of the three largest proper divisors of a_n. When a_1 is 6 * 12^k * m, where m is coprime to 10. Please prove that a_n exists.'

The glue is 27 lines (3900-3926) and the four children span 9, 36, 41 and 417 lines respectively (3389-3397, 3400-3435, 3438-3478, 3481-3897); all four children close without invoking any further project lemma (depth 1), and `imo2025_p4_right8_h1` closes by `by_contra` plus `norm_num` alone.

consequences: The ∃-goal becomes `use ⟨witness⟩` plus three `constructor` obligations, one per conjunct, each discharged by a pre-packaged lemma, so a missing conjunct is a missing lemma rather than a partial proof. The obligations are coupled through the lemmas' hypotheses: h2 needs h1 (`n ≥ 1`), h3 needs h2 (positivity), and right1_main needs all three, so the glue must assemble the `have`s in order and re-state each exact type. The witness is a closed-form term with an `if m ≤ k` branch, so any later step that computes the witness at a specific index must simplify the `if` first; the `a 0 = a0` conjunct is discharged by `simp only [ha0]; aesop` rather than by a named lemma, so if `ha0` were stated differently that branch would need its own fact.
known_uses: the same `refine ⟨w, …⟩` witness introduction recurs inside `imo2025_p4_right1_main` itself, which returns its three largest proper divisors by `refine ⟨s, 2 * s, 3 * s, ?_, …⟩` (line 3665) and `refine ⟨3 * t, 4 * t, 6 * t, ?_, …⟩` (line 3856) (https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Seed-Prover/blob/38c59cebaf969ac259196eb091757518d5b54c67/SeedProver/imo2025/IMO2025/P4.lean#L3665)
